meta.name: Take My Brother Away 720p
meta.description:
Bickering siblings Shi Miao and Shi Fen tackle friendship matters, school drama and the pitfalls of growing up with little parental supervision.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 28 Jun 2018 · CN · Language: Chinese · 45 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 30/30

On your server — Audio: Chinese

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: High School student Shi Miao has a love-hate relationship with her brother Shi-Fe, who embarrasses her in front of popular classmate Wang Keke.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Shi Fen bribes a classmate for advice on wooing his crush and bickers with Shi Miao over meal coupons -- but decides to be the bigger person.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Gullible Wan Sui arrives at school with his wunderkind brother to see how the other half lives. But thanks to Shi Fen, he faces the silent treatment.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The clock ticks for the bathroom-door vandal to turn herself in. When You Le asks Wan Sui for his phone number, Shi Fen decides to show him who's boss.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Miao Miaomiao sees Shi Fen scuffling with Shi Miao and mistakes him for her boyfriend. Shi Miao shares an essay about her and Shi Fen as children.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Wan Sui returns from Shi Fen's birthday night with misguided notions about ordinary life. Wan Xing is alarmed by Shi Fen's influence on his brother.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Wan Sui tries to look after an ill and drowsy Shi Fen. Wang Keke turns the class against Shi Miao, who's prepared to audition for the class promo video.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: You Le agrees to a date with Shi Fen if he raises his test scores. Shi Miao helps Miaomiao with a recording and finds a new talent that earns her fans.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Shi Miao bombs her tests and takes her anger out on Miaomiao, who's at the top of the class. Shi Fen's friends help him track down his missing exam.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Shi Fen grooms himself for the beach outing, but Shi Miao wakes up with an inferiority complex. Cheng Haonan is suspicious of Wan Sui's real identity.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Shi Fen's class is assigned to military training. When Miaomiao gets emotionally attached to the chickens she's feeding, Shi Miao helps her free them.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: An inebriated Wan Xing tells Shi Miao she lacks female role models in her life. Shi Fen helps Wan Xing find a phone signal for a charitable transaction.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Rumors swirl around a haunted building at camp, and Wang Keke tricks Shi Miao into entering the site, where a masked man goes after Wan Sui.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Zhen Kaixin faces pressure on all fronts when his mom forces him to quit basketball, and Shi Fen must fill his shoes -- but his coordination is rusty.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Shi Fen has trouble convincing the team to play a tougher defense, but the coach is on his side. Wan Sui gives the security guard cupping therapy.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: On game day, Shi Miao gives Shi Fen her charm bracelet, which nets mixed results. At a critical moment, Kaixin barges onto the basketball court.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: During a time-suspended slam dunk, Shi Fen reflects on his friendship with Kaixin, whose mom has a change of heart about her son playing basketball.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Shi Fen bonds with the school security guard on a sailboat and convinces himself the man could be his real dad, but something smells fishy to Shi Miao.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Shi Miao schemes to expose the security guard, who reveals to Shi Fen his troubled past and his connection to Wan Sui and Wan Xing.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Wan Yi falls asleep from spiked beer, and Wan Sui is abducted. The Wan brothers' mom calls the school doctor, driving a wedge between her and Wan Yi.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Shi Fen is puzzled by Wan Sui's high-spiritedness, despite Wan Yi's absence. Shi Miao asks Kaixin to cosplay over break, but he has other plans.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: During the Lunar New Year, Shi Miao dislocates her shoulders posing for photos. Shi Fen arrives home to find his dad beaten by debt collectors.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Miaomiao speaks to Wan Sui in an alternate dimension. The siblings face a financial dilemma, but Shi Fen forbids Shi Miao from using her travel fund.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Shi Fen comes up with a homework copying scheme to help pay for Shi Miao's fees. Hao Ren loses faith in humanity when rumors swirl around Mr. Lu's past.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Shi Miao's grades improve. After arguing with his mom, Wan Xing leaves home with Wan Sui in tow, but discovers his bank accounts have been frozen.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The Shi siblings get lost on the way to their grandpa's town. Wan Sui's mom makes him choose between school and Wan Yi -- but Wan Sui wants it all.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: When Shi Miao suddenly goes off the grid, Shi Fen plays detective to track her down, only to find his sister has completely transformed.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Shi Miao pushes everyone away at school and assumes a rebellious persona under the tutelage of Sister Fang -- at the cost of sibling relations.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: After a heated argument with Shi Miao, Shi Fen moves out to stay with their mom and her zany, wealthy, aggressively doting husband, Mr. Wang.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: As her friends keep the accident a secret, Shi Miao sees visions of Shi Fen and visits a clinic, where she finds a helmet that's said to erase memories.
